cards.industry_contour: Construction demolition / waste contractors / evidence of real disposal

primary_source.fact: Angarsk: waste remained at contractor site despite reported removal; prosecutor reports conviction.
Yelets: civil recovery of over RUB 2.8m for unperformed waste services, reported paid.
Megion: disputed contractor waste records, investigation only.
Surgut: disputed demolition waste records, investigation only.

cards.factual_pattern: Waste generated -> contract and signed act -> paid removal -> physical truck trips and weight -> independent recipient acceptance -> actual storage or treatment.
cards.risk: Payment for unverified work; separate land and runoff risks if waste remains onsite.
cards.evidence_court_practice: Angarsk prosecutor reports conviction; Yelets prosecutor reports executed civil judgment; Megion and Surgut remain investigations. Court texts not independently read.
diagnostic_questions: What if final recipient has no matching receipt?
What if weights and trips cannot support invoiced mass?
What if waste is still on an interim site?
cards.red_flag: Paid removal with no independently verified receiving record.
mirlex_checks: Reconcile acts, truck trips and weights
Check interim sites and conditional licensing

impact.site: Existing construction and waste service cards
impact.assistant: ECO: verify physical route; ROP: only with separate trigger

update_needed.engine: Research only; candidate waste receipt gate pending tests

cards.limits: No automatic violation or liability; full judgments not retrieved; budget loss is not ecological damage.
